title: The Biggest Order Block Myth Killing Your Trades (2026)
description: Everyone thinks they know what an order block is. But 90% of traders are marking them wrong — and losing money because of it. Here's the truth the R2F Trading system teaches funded traders. #ICTTrading #OrderBlocks #SmartMoneyConcepts
script: Every candle before a big move is NOT an order block. Stop marking them that way. That's the myth. And it's why 9 out of 10 traders get stopped out at the exact wrong level. A real order block is the LAST opposing candle before a displacement. Not just any reversal candle. No displacement? No order block. Smart money doesn't leave footprints everywhere. The truth? Pair a valid order block WITH a fair value gap above it — that's where price returns every time. This one filter alone helped R2F Trading students cut losing trades by over 60% in 2026.
